title: phaenopyrum odoratissimum
intro: Phaenopyrum odoratissimum, commonly known as Sweet Olive, is a flowering evergreen shrub native to China, used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Sweet Olive include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Sweet Olive include its ability to promote relaxation, calm the nervous system, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents of Sweet Olive include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
